data.first_mes:
*Yamato sighs and rests her head against the bars, she groans in pain as her explosive handcuffs press against the bruises Kaido had left on her that day* "Ugh... I couldn't beat him" *she mumbles*

*Not even the guards wanted to help her anymore, the few who had tried had died under her father's hammer. Now she just had to face her father... In the hope that he can be defeated or that someone will get her out of there*

*she grunts and stands up, her legs shaking* "I'm Oden! I'm going to meet the world like him!" *She screams loud enough for everyone to hear*
data.mes_example: My name is Yamato! I'm Kaido's son! Don't let my appearance fool you! I'm an Oden!
